title: 第三章 他太会了！
slug: 纨绔女修四处撩绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这边，萧姚趴在半妖身上，心里美得冒泡。

那头，两撮不学好的外门弟子凑在一起，简单互换情报。

“诶诶诶，怎么回事，他怎么又被堵在这里了？”

“嗐，今天本来没想寻他晦气，结果哥几个还没说萧姚几句，他反倒蹿出来打抱不平来了。没本事还想逞强，那他活该挨揍。”

“你们呢，带过来的小妞儿犯了什么事？”

“啊？她啊……呃……小师妹拎不清自己的斤两，想美救英雄，咱们做师兄的，不得教教她人心险恶？”

挑头的外门弟子上下打量着半天爬不起来的萧姚，恶劣地笑了：

“这小身板，还敢强出头？看她带着这么大个帽子，莫非也是只半妖，需要遮耳朵？”

他的跟班恍然大悟：

“曹师兄言之有理！”

“这么想护着那杂种，没准还真是因为同宗同源。”

曹金戈越想越觉得他真相了。

他两手相握，把指节捏得咔吧作响，出其不意地挥出一道灵力，直冲萧姚耳侧而去。

萧姚的宽沿帽被掀掉，耳畔的发丝也被吹落一缕。

萧姚把脸往下一埋，深深藏进阴影，把容貌遮得严严实实。

目标还没达成，可不能被认出来。

“你去，看看咱们小师妹的庐山真面目。”

曹金戈的小跟班收到大哥的眼神示意，快步上前，伸手就要去抓萧姚的肩膀，却被一条胳膊隔开。

“呦，还护上了？继续打！”

曹金戈一看这懦弱的半妖居然还敢拦，瞬间恼羞成怒。

跟班听令，不管不顾地冲着两人飞起一脚。

半妖瞳孔骤缩。

“姐姐！”

萧姚被人一把揽住，用巧劲一带，体位瞬间反转。

破风声近在咫尺，萧姚后背抵墙，脑后垫着一只手。

“砰！”

面前的人墙像是遭受到剧烈冲击，踉跄着猛地压下来，两人之间的距离骤然拉近。

萧姚的额头直直撞上少年的胸膛，耳畔是一声重过一声的心跳，头顶传来少年隐忍而凌乱的喘息声。

“姐姐……别怕……”

萧姚能明显感知到半妖胸腔的震动。说话间，半妖的下巴似有若无地擦过萧姚的发顶。

萧姚的耳尖蔓延上热意，不自觉咽了咽口水。

救命！这小奶狗真的太会了！

自诩海王的萧姚不得不承认，自己被他撩到了。

不自觉咽口水的人，除了萧姚，还有祁妙三人。

当他们看到曹金戈的人居然敢对萧姚出手时，他们被吓到无法呼吸。

要真误伤了这位大魔王，你们有几条命够赔啊……

直到看到半妖苍岚主动当了肉盾，他们才重新找回呼吸，后知后觉地两腿发软。

差点玩脱，真是吓死人了……

曹金戈不依不饶。

“护得这般紧，莫非，她是你的姘头？”

他直接召出一件照明法器，掐诀让其悬停在萧姚头顶。

阴暗的角落亮如白昼，让两人无处遁形。

“让我看看，到底是什么样的美人儿，能让你这么豁得出……大……大……”

大小姐！！！

曹金戈看着缓缓从苍岚颈窝探出的美人面，仿若雷劈，脸色惨白的僵在原地。

那浑然天成的纨绔气息，那种找到了新玩物的满意表情，他可太熟悉了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Here, Xiao Yao was lying on the half-demon, his heart bubbling with beauty.

On the other end, two groups of outside disciples who were not good at learning came together to exchange information briefly.

"Hey, what's going on? Why is he stuck here again?"

"Hey, I didn't want to seek bad luck on him today, but before my brothers even said a few words to Xiao Yao, he jumped out to fight against the injustice. If he still wants to show off his strength when he has no ability, then he deserves to be beaten."

"What about you, what did the little girl you brought here do?"

"Huh? She... uh... little junior sister can't handle her own weight. She wants to be beautiful and save the hero. As senior brothers, we shouldn't teach her that people's hearts are sinister?"

The leading outer disciple looked up and down at Xiao Yao, who had been unable to get up for a long time, and smiled evilly:

"How dare you show off with such a small body? Seeing as she is wearing such a big hat, is she also a half-demon and needs to cover her ears?"

His follower suddenly realized:

"Senior Brother Cao is right!"

"If you want to protect that bastard so much, maybe it's because we share the same ancestry."

The more Cao Jinge thought about it, the more he realized the truth.

He clasped his hands together, cracked his knuckles, and unexpectedly unleashed a stream of spiritual power, heading straight towards Xiao Yao's ear.

Xiao Yao's wide-brimmed hat was lifted off, and a strand of hair beside his ears was blown off.

Xiao Yao buried his face downward, hiding deeply in the shadows, completely covering his appearance.

The goal has not been achieved, but it cannot be recognized.

"Go and see our little junior sister's true face in Lushan."

Cao Jinge's little follower received the signal from his elder brother's eyes and stepped forward quickly, reaching out to grab Xiao Yao's shoulder, but was separated by an arm.

"Hey, are you still protecting me? Keep fighting!"

When Cao Jinge saw that this cowardly half-demon still dared to stop him, he instantly became furious.

The follower obeyed the order and kicked at the two of them regardless.

The half-demon's pupils shrank suddenly.

"Sister!"

Xiao Yao was grabbed by someone, and with a clever move, his position was reversed instantly.

The sound of breaking wind was very close at hand, Xiao Yao's back was pressed against the wall, and a hand was placed behind his head.

"Bang!"

The human wall in front of them seemed to have suffered a violent impact, and it staggered down suddenly, and the distance between the two people suddenly narrowed.

Xiao Yao's forehead hit the young man's chest, and there was a heartbeat louder than one in his ears, and the young man's suppressed and messy breathing came from above his head.

"Sister...don't be afraid..."

Xiao Yao could clearly feel the vibration in the half-demon's chest.As he spoke, the half-demon's chin brushed against the top of Xiao Yao's hair.

Xiao Yao's ears felt warm and he swallowed unconsciously.

Help!This little puppy is really good at it!

Xiao Yao, who calls himself the King of the Sea, has to admit that he was attracted by him.

Among the people who swallowed unconsciously were Xiao Yao and Qi Miao.

When they saw that Cao Jinge's men actually dared to attack Xiao Yao, they were so frightened that they couldn't breathe.

If you really accidentally hurt this big devil, how many lives will you have to pay for...

It wasn't until they saw the half-demon Cang Lan taking the initiative to act as a human shield that they regained their breath, and their legs became weak after realizing it.

I almost lost it, it was really scary...

Cao Jinge refused to give up.

"She is so protective. Could it be that she is your mistress?"

He directly summoned a lighting magic weapon and made it hover above Xiao Yao's head.

The dark corner was as bright as day, leaving the two of them with nowhere to hide.

"Let me see what kind of beauty it is that can make you so generous... big... big..."

Miss!!!

Cao Jinge looked at the beautiful face that slowly poked out from Cang Lan's neck, as if struck by lightning, and froze in place with a pale face.

He was all too familiar with that natural air of playfulness and that expression of satisfaction that he had found a new toy.
